app.message: Service web is routed by Traefik but has no healthcheck; traffic starts as soon as the container starts
Traefik labels in labels are used on Kubernetes; on Swarm Traefik only reads deploy.labels
basicauth.users uses \, or \\ to keep a comma or a backslash in a value; Traefik on Swarm has no escape and splits the same label differently
app.hint: Avoid commas inside values when the same file is also deployed on Swarm.
